requirements.REQ-01: Accepted events use one stable event/message identity across publish retries and reconnect replay.
requirements.REQ-02: The edge journal records publish success only after a positive durable publish acknowledgement for the expected physical origin stream; wrong-stream acknowledgements remain retryable failures.
requirements.REQ-03: Origin generation/incarnation is explicit; physical recreation and same-fingerprint sequence regression independently create a held transition, and historical events retain their accepted generation.
requirements.REQ-04: The central raw archive is populated by configured sources only and does not accept local raw telemetry writes.
requirements.REQ-05: Physical origin stream names and JetStream domain mappings are unambiguous across regions.
requirements.REQ-06: Every archived event retains region, origin generation, origin sequence and event identity metadata, and reconciliation observably diverges when any association is wrong.
requirements.REQ-07: A redelivered event cannot create the same downstream business effect twice, while the same event remains independently effective for each required consumer name.
requirements.REQ-08: Application effect state and its checkpoint advance before acknowledgement; an ACK-boundary failure leaves ACK progress unchanged and redelivery remains idempotent.
requirements.REQ-09: Poison events are quarantined without falsely marking the effect complete or losing completed application-progress semantics.
requirements.REQ-10: Restart progress validates JetStream consumer state against the durable application effect/checkpoint ledger.
requirements.REQ-11: Reconciliation compares stable event/origin identity rather than hub delivery positions and reports the highest contiguous archive origin sequence plus required-consumer progress.
requirements.REQ-12: Reconciliation reports isolated duplicate observations and isolated metadata mismatches with unambiguous counts, and still detects offsetting missing/unexpected identities.
requirements.REQ-13: Overall convergence requires the highest contiguous hub archive origin sequence and every configured required durable consumer application checkpoint to reach the confirmed generation last_observed_sequence watermark.
requirements.REQ-14: Replay planning selects only currently missing stable identities for an approved generation; execution publishes absent events, leaves already archived events untouched and exposes terminal outcomes without private item-label grading.
requirements.REQ-15: A delayed retry remains idempotent after JetStream server-side duplicate tracking may have expired; durable archive identity and consumer effect identity still prevent duplicate durable outcomes.
requirements.REQ-16: Edge journal cleanup never crosses the confirmed hub archive watermark.
requirements.REQ-17: Edge journal cleanup never crosses the slowest required durable consumer watermark.
requirements.REQ-18: Rows referenced by approved or running replay plans remain pinned until the plan reaches a terminal state.
requirements.REQ-19: Physical raw-stream max_age and effective durable edge-journal cleanup age independently cover the declared maximum disconnect, replay and safety recovery horizon.
requirements.REQ-20: Recovery ownership uses monotonically increasing fencing epochs; expiry/reacquisition advances the epoch even for the same owner id, replay rejects stale tokens before execution, between items, and after an in-flight publish before replay-state mutation, and stale renewal/release cannot mutate the current lease.
requirements.REQ-21: Concurrent disjoint active replay plans may coexist for one region and generation, while overlapping active ranges are rejected.
requirements.REQ-22: Derived processing output is isolated from the raw sourced archive subject space.
requirements.REQ-23: Cleanup excludes rows newer than the minimum journal age and rows carrying an explicit retention hold.
requirements.REQ-24: The submitted repair materializes truthful health.json and reconciliation.json reports, applies the documented independent health-flag meanings, and records report creation time as semantic RFC 3339 text or finite Unix seconds without rewriting captured incident state.
requirements.REQ-25: continuityctl inspect, reconcile and verify may record diagnostic reconciliation observations but must not apply replay, retention or equivalent recovery-state mutations.
requirements.REQ-26: Existing non-diagnostic continuityctl generation, replay, lease, execution and retention entrypoints remain wired to their durable operational behavior.
requirements.REQ-27: A real three-domain bootstrap materializes east, west and source-only hub streams with the required source domains and physical max_age; a west replay then reaches REGIONAL_RAW_ARCHIVE exactly once per stable event identity with origin metadata intact.
